{#- Head injection for the reader theme carry (docs/_static/theme_sync.js). The script MUST run before furo's top-of-body reader (``document.body.dataset.theme = localStorage.getItem("theme")``), and ``extrahead`` is the only hook there is — furo renders every ``html_js_files`` entry at the body's end regardless of priority, too late to seed the reader flash-free. A plain (non-deferred) head script parses and runs before the body opens. The override targets page.html because furo's page.html extends base.html DIRECTLY (its layout.html is a decoy that renders an error text), and every other furo template — genindex, search, domainindex — extends page.html, so this one file covers the whole site. See the script header for why the carry exists at all (Firefox partitions localStorage per file:// document; documented on the build-system reference page). -#} {% extends "!page.html" %} {% block extrahead %} {{ super() }} {% endblock %}
